''See also: [[Ghostwater Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Ghostwater is a world originally designed by the [[Monarch]] [[Northstrider]] to house a research facility. The realm was abandoned by its creator nearly fifty years before his death and was eventually sealed away. Following its closure, the facility was looted by [[Heralds]], and over time, most of its spiritual [[inhabitants]] faded, leaving behind only physical vessels or fragments of [[madra]] preserved by [[scripts]]. The world is characterized by an ocean composed of [[blood]] and dust, containing specimen tanks and various security measures or relics left by ancient [[Soulsmiths]]. The facility's primary chamber is a hollowed-out cave containing an [[oracle tree]]. Attempts to create transportation gates to the realm were historically fatal, as spatial transmission errors caused travelers to blow apart. Eventually, the world suffered a catastrophic collapse due to failing anchors and extreme spatial distortions, leading to its [[destruction]]. The name of the world is derived from a specific substance known as ghostwater. This liquid is a highly prized treasure that can be used to enhance a person's mental foundation, strengthen the body, or increase reflexes. When consumed, a single drop can fuse with an individual's [[madra channels]] and nest at the base of the skull, acting as a source of power that restores itself by drawing from the user's body and [[spirit]]. While earlier versions of similar wells were merely prototypes, a true drop of ghostwater is considered a significant prize. Additionally, the [[spirit]] [[Dross]] is identified as a unique creation born from the final days of Ghostwater.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Created by the [[Monarch]] [[Northstrider]] to house a research facility, Ghostwater is an icy, vast ocean [[pocket world]] containing a bubble of [[water aura]]. Although it was sealed away and looted by [[Heralds]] for years, the location recently saw activity from the [[Tidewalker sect]] and a [[Ninecloud Court]] delegation. The world contains treasures, including a prize known only to the [[Akura clan|Akura family]] and a substance used in an attempt to create other wells. Because its anchor [[binding]] is damaged, this dying world is expected to crumble within a few weeks or months. During his month spent there, [[Lindon]] witnessed the rejuvenation of [[Orthos]]' mind, body, and [[spirit]], while a boy on the ground consumed two drops of the substance.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Ghostwater is an island featuring a cave marked by a [[Jade|jade]] doorframe. During his recent visit to the location, [[Lindon]] discovered upgrades for his soul and body, as well as [[Underlord dream tablets]]. The island also provided meat that offers enhancements and served as a site where [[Dross]] absorbed various information [[constructs]]. Although [[Northstrider]] attempted to establish transportation gates to the island, the group eventually departed the area by [[cloudship]].}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Ghostwater is a unique location that can be accessed through doorframes. This realm served as the birthplace of [[Dross]] and once hosted several [[Heralds]] as guests. While [[Northstrider's pocket world]] resembles a miniature version of this place, the original Ghostwater was eventually destroyed when [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] burned it. Following this event, her portion of the realm ceased to exist.}}
